title: Add a list item
summary: Dart: Add a list item. Add 9 too. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A List keeps values in order. add places a new value at the end.
learningObjectives: Add a list item with Dart

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.

blocks.title: Add a list item

blocks.text: add puts 8 after 4 and 5. The list then has three items.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The first position in a List is zero.
